# Predefined macros of IAR iccarm (IAR C/C++ Compiler for Arm).
#
# Format (as the EDG C/C++ front end's predefined_macros.txt):
#   mode[,mode]   cannot_redefine   name   value
#
# Generated by tools/predefined-macros/generate.sh on 2026-11-20, from the
# vendor's documentation: the IAR C/C++ Development Guide for Arm, chapter "Predefined symbols". The compiler cannot be run here, so the table lists its
# documented macros, not a full -dM dump; a real installation defines more.
# C:   not documented by the vendor
# C++: not documented by the vendor
#
# The identity macros IAR's guide documents: __VER__ encodes the version as VVRRPPPP
# (9.40 -> 9400000), the way CMSIS' headers read it.
iar no  __BUILD_NUMBER__ 1
iar no  __IAR_SYSTEMS_ICC__ 9
iar no  __ICCARM__ 1
iar no  __VER__ 9400000
